sentences.text: This appeal has been filed by the claimant in O.P(MV) No.1059/2017 on the file of the Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal, Ernakulam, seeking enhancement of the compensation amount awarded by the tribunal.

2. When the matter came up for hearing today, the learned counsel for both sides submitted that the matter has been settled between the parties before the Mediator, Kerala High Court Mediation Centre and memorandum of agreement dated 10.02.2026 has been filed.
3.
The terms of mediation settlement agreement arrived at between the parties is lawful and is therefore recorded.

In view of the terms of memorandum of agreement and the settlement arrived at by the parties, the 3rd respondent/ insurer shall pay an additional consolidated amount of 1,30,000/- (Rupees One lakh thirty thousand only), inclusive of interest and costs, as agreed in the memorandum of agreement, towards full and final settlement of the claims advanced in this appeal within a period of two months from the date of receipt of this judgment, MACA NO.2090 OF 2020 2026:KER:28911 : 4 :

sentences.text: failing which, the 3rd respondent/ insurer shall pay interest @ 7% per annum for the said amount from the date of default.

The claimant shall furnish copies of the PAN Card, AADHAAR Card and bank details before the 3rd respondent/ insurer within a period of one month from the date of receipt of a certified copy of this judgment so as to enable the insurance company to make the deposit as ordered above.
In case of failure to furnish details as above, it shall be open for the insurance company to deposit the said amount before the Tribunal.
The appeal is disposed of, in terms of the memorandum of agreement, which do form part of this judgment.
